body:
## Summary

Closes #5356.

## Findings Resolved

- IR-5356-002: v0.91.8 release-tail entrypoints now show WP-18 as active after closed WP-17.
- IR-5356-003: WP-18 validation lanes now execute and emit structured JSON instead of failing as a preparation stub.
- IR-5356-004: Runtime API advertised endpoints now match served routes, with focused contract proof.

## Validation

- Full local WP-18 lane pass at 9d5c0b5f73243cf332df41236164d822c0c7c264: freeze-corpus, code, security, tests, docs, architecture, evidence, synthesis, review-quality, complete, post-merge-exact.
- csdlc-doctor passed at implemented and reviewed phases.
- Final read-only exact-head review returned CLEAN for 9d5c0b5f73243cf332df41236164d822c0c7c264.

No AWS operations were performed. WP-19 external review and release approval are not claimed.
